nom: PEACH & LILY Pure Radiance Brightening Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with sensitive eyes specifically, report the cream is gentle, soothing, and reduces dark circles without irritation; dissent is real, though, with one reviewer breaking out near her nose despite otherwise loving the brand, another returning it because her eyes watered constantly, and one noting a single instance of irritation.
segments.normal: The two reviewers who describe their skin as normal, or say they rarely react to products, are the exception to the generally gentle reputation of this cream: one had it burn and dry out the skin around her eyes, and the other developed a red, stinging, swollen rash.
segments.dry: The few reviewers with dry skin, including dry under-eyes specifically, report the cream provides lasting moisture that their regular face moisturizer does not reach.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report a firming or smoothing effect on fine lines and describe their eye area looking younger or less tired, including one in her 30s who says it undid fine lines that had appeared after going without an eye cream; one reviewer in her 40s, however, used it faithfully for weeks and saw no change in the signs of aging around her eyes.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the cream as strongly hydrating and moisturizing for the delicate eye area, some noting it works across humid, dry, or cold climates; dissent comes from a couple of reviewers, one calling it very drying and another saying it was not hydrating enough, with her eyes feeling dry by the end of the day.
concerns.redness: One reviewer who does not normally react to products developed a red, stinging, swollen rash around her eyes; by contrast, another reviewer who says most eye creams leave her eyes red and irritated reports this one does not, calling it a game changer.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer highlights the cream's ceramide content as genuinely supporting the skin barrier rather than being a token ingredient; against that, two reviewers who do not normally react to skincare report their skin around the eyes burned, dried out, or broke into a swollen rash after using it.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report their dark circles visibly lighten, sometimes within two to three days, several calling it the first eye cream that has ever worked for hereditary or long-standing dark circles; a consistent minority, however, report no change in under-eye darkness despite weeks of use, several adding that the cream is hydrating even though it did not brighten for them.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports breaking out near her nose where her glasses rest, with the pimples clearing within two days of stopping use; by contrast, another reviewer notes she has had no breakouts even when the cream accidentally spread onto her browbone or nose, which has happened with other eye creams.

aspects.libelle: Rich, creamy texture that still absorbs without grease
Small jar, runs out quickly for the price
A little product goes a long way
Can make eyes water if applied too close to the lash line
Auto-ship subscription reorders without adequate notice
Sits well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: Got a free sample in a gift with purchase, burns so bad and dried out the skin around my eyes. I have relatively normal skin and very rarely have reactions from products. I would throw this straight in the trash, even if it was free.

extraits.titre: Wanted to love but it made me break out
extraits.texte: I LOVE this brand normally. I am a ginger with very sensitive skin and most of this brand works wonders. However, this product made me break out around my nose where the bridge of my glasses rests. This was not a problem before I started using this product and the pimples disappeared two days after I stopped using it. So I guess my advice would be this: If you have sensitive skin, this brand in general is wonderful. However, be careful with this product. Especially if you wear glasses every day.
I'm not someone with sensitive skin and not allergic to anything. However, this caused the skin around my eyes to get a red, stinging, rash that got swollen and wrinkled and flaky.

extraits.titre: Average, nothing to report. Only sadness :(
extraits.texte: Okay so I'm not sure who the 5 people are that said this stuff is a game changer but I've been using it for weeks after a store associate talked me into it and I've seen no results. I'm not 18 nor did I get lucky with skin. I have eye oldness even though I've been faithful to good face care my entire life. This is the 3rd eye cream I have ever bought as I seek the holy grail of eye creams. 40 years old, ex smoker & 3 kids (one is 6 months!) and I have been eating better and drinking more water so if there was going to be a change under the eyeballs, 3 weeks in, I would have seen it by now. Using 2x a day.

This eye cream is hydrating, but that's about all it did for me. It keeps my makeup from creasing under my eyes and helps my under eye area feel more hydrated, but it didn't do anything in terms of making my dark circles look better or brightening my under eyes. I like that it doesn't have any harsh ingredients that would irritate my eyes. I may purchase again in the future, but will look for something more effective for now.

This eye cream is lovely! Deeply moisturizing but not greasy. I have dry eyes & often wake up with swollen, puffy eyelids. Putting this on makes a noticeable difference to the color and puff, as well as smoothing out my deep purple underyes. A possible downside is that for sensitive eyes, the cream could irritate them - I did experience that once, although that could have been down to other factors, as I haven't had issues since. But in general, this cream brightens beautifully & feels comfortable.

Context: Mid-30s, no significant wrinkles in the skin around the eyes yet. A few fine lines if you're looking extremely close. Not a daily eye makeup-wearer. *Very* faint partial undereye circles (from poor sleep habits). This is a good nighttime eye cream! I like how dense it is - a dab is all that's needed in my routine. I had run out of my previous eye cream (CosRX) and was recommended P&L by a friend, so I gave this eye cream a shot during the end-of-year sale. After ~2 weeks of being without an eye cream, the P&L did appear to immediately undo some of the visible dryness & very fine lines that were starting to appear without my nighttime eye moisturiser. I haven't noticed other changes, but wasn't expecting anything huge (my very light undereye dark areas are primarily influenced by sleeping habits, which P&L unfortunately can't fix for me). This cream has a satisfying texture to it, and it applies & spreads easily without any sticking or pulling at the delicate skin of the eye area. I have not experienced any breakouts if I accidentally spread the cream too far (ex, up to the browbone or over into the bridge of my nose, which has happened with other eye creams). I would repurchase this cream.
